"""Offline arbitration baseline only. No Backend, SQLite, browser or business I/O."""
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace
from src.workflow.service import WorkflowRuntime

def seed(first, tp_due):
    clock = SimpleNamespace(t=-900.0)
    run = WorkflowRuntime(None, None, ())
    run.configure_modules({first: 900, 'tp': 900}, timer=lambda: clock.t)
    assert run.claim_due_module() == first
    run.complete_module(first)  # prior first-module due is0
    assert run.claim_due_module() == 'tp'
    clock.t = tp_due - 900
    run.complete_module('tp')
    clock.t = 0
    assert run.claim_due_module() == first
    return run, clock

run, clock = seed('quotation', 9.825)
clock.t = 9.825
assert run.claim_due_module() is None  # TP due, quotation still holds Owner
clock.t = 492.874
assert run.claim_due_module() is None
run.complete_module('quotation')
clock.t = 492.948
assert run.claim_due_module() == 'tp'
assert abs((clock.t - 9.825) - 483.123) < 1e-9
run.complete_module('tp')
quote = {'case': 'quoted whole-cycle occupancy', 'due': 9.825, 'owner_released': 492.874,
         'tp_start': 492.948, 'delay': 483.123, 'remaining_occupancy': 483.049, 'handoff': 0.074}

run, clock = seed('inquiry', 10.887)
clock.t = 10.887
assert run.claim_due_module() is None
clock.t = 107.653  # closed-row SOURCE_CHANGED, not an invented timer
run.yield_module_resource('inquiry')
clock.t = 107.679
assert run.claim_due_module(exclude=('inquiry',)) == 'tp'
assert abs((clock.t - 10.887) - 96.792) < 1e-9
clock.t = 115.955
run.complete_module('tp')
run.resume_module_resource('inquiry')
run.complete_module('inquiry')
inq = {'case': 'inquiry closed-row release', 'due': 10.887, 'owner_released': 107.653,
       'tp_start': 107.679, 'delay': 96.792, 'remaining_occupancy': 96.766, 'handoff': 0.026}

clock = SimpleNamespace(t=-900.0)
run = WorkflowRuntime(None, None, ())
run.configure_modules({'quotation': 900, 'tp': 900}, timer=lambda: clock.t)
assert run.claim_due_module() == 'quotation'
run.complete_module('quotation')
assert run.claim_due_module() == 'tp'
clock.t = -899
run.complete_module('tp')
clock.t = 5
assert run.claim_due_module() == 'quotation'  # earliest due, no implicit TP priority
run.complete_module('quotation')
assert run.claim_due_module() == 'tp'
run.complete_module('tp')
print(json.dumps({'passed_scenarios': 3, 'cases': [quote, inq], 'third_case': 'earliest-due selection retains quotation ahead of later-due TP',
 'qualification': 'Real canonical runtime arbitration with synthetic clock. Handoffs supplied from prior reviewed logs, not measured wall time. No domain execution or new real-timeliness PASS.120s and authentication/lease/effect guards not exercised by this narrow baseline.'}, indent=2))
